task: Make the File Datasource 10-file upload limit configurable (default 10) and add batch processing for file upload to support hundreds of files without performance degradation.

key_reasoning.reason: Four distinct components requiring coordination: (1) two unrelated request model classes (IndexKnowledgeBaseFileRequest and UpdateKnowledgeBaseFileRequest) with no shared base class, (2) dual config systems (env var in config.py + YAML model in datasources_config.py + datasources-config.yaml), (3) FileDatasourceService upload loop, (4) FileDatasourceProcessor and FileDatasourceUpdateProcessor — the update processor overrides process() verbatim so base changes do not propagate automatically.

~10-11 modified files across 6+ directories: index.py, config.py, datasources_config.py, datasources-config.yaml, file_datasource_service.py, file_datasource_processor.py, file_datasource_update_processor.py, plus test_index_models.py, test_file_datasource_service.py, test_file_datasource_processor.py, and possibly test_update_file_datasource_use_case.py.

Four layers: API (request model validators in rest_api/models/index.py), Service (FileDatasourceService upload batching), Workflow/Processor (FileDatasourceProcessor and FileDatasourceUpdateProcessor batch size), Config/Infrastructure (app config.py env var + YAML config). No DB schema migration, no cross-system calls.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from S (2) to M (3): performance/scalability is an explicit primary concern — batch processing is required to prevent performance impact when uploading hundreds of files.
